input: Find founder-owned US commercial HVAC service companies in Texas with 50-300 employees and no institutional investors

companies.name: AirCo Air Conditioning, Heating, and Plumbing

criteria_evidence.evidence: The Texas HVAC company list identifies AirCo's headquarters as Fort Worth, Texas, USA.

BBB categorizes AirCo as a Commercial Air Conditioning Contractor and lists Commercial AC and Commercial Heating among its products and services; AirCo's own site includes Commercial HVAC as a service option.
The Texas HVAC company list reports a 51-200 employee range, which is within the requested 50-300 range.

Inven labels AirCo Family Owned; AirCo's own site says Family-owned & Operated for over 35 years; BBB identifies Rick Thornton as owner and the entity as private. The opened sources verify family ownership and a current owner, but do not explicitly state that Rick Thornton was the original founder.

The reviewed company and BBB pages describe AirCo as family-owned/private and identify an individual owner; no institutional or PE owner is disclosed on those pages. This is a source-screening result, not proof that no undisclosed investor exists.
The Texas HVAC company list reports founded year 1990, and AirCo's own site says it has served the Dallas-Fort Worth community since 1990.

companies.traction: AirCo's site reports 42,000+ HVAC systems installed, Trane Comfort Specialist status, and Trane Top 10 Dealer Award recognition for 14 consecutive years; it also displays a 2021 Angi Super Service Award.
companies.rank_reason: Only verified survivor of the reviewed Texas commercial-HVAC screen: it has the requested 50-300 employee range, Texas headquarters, explicit commercial HVAC evidence, and family/private ownership with no institutional owner disclosed. It ranks first despite the caveat that the opened sources do not explicitly identify the current owner as the original founder; dated headcount growth and a last funding round were not verifiable.

output.search_notes: As_of: 2026-11-09. I screened the Inven Texas HVAC list, official company pages, BBB profiles, and opened M&A/PE sources. AirCo is the only company I could retain as a verified family-owned/private commercial HVAC fit in the 50-300 range. Prodigy Commercial HVAC was excluded because PitchBook identifies it as private-equity-backed by Audax; Rescue Air was excluded because PitchBook identifies it as acquired/merged and PE-backed; Frymire was found within the Granite Comfort organization. Exact structured employee counts also removed several otherwise plausible family/private names that fell below 50, while Houk's sources indicated a size conflict with the requested ceiling. Two dated headcount observations and a last funding round were not found for AirCo, so those fields are null. The no-institutional-investor conclusion is limited to the reviewed public pages and is not a guarantee against undisclosed ownership. Sources: https://www.inven.ai/company-lists/top-25-hvac-companies-in-texas; https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/626877-28; https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/451654-12; https://granitecomfort.com/granite-comfort-expands-footprint-in-dallas-ft-worth-metroplex-with-acquisition-strittmatter
